translations.literal: Yet what they preached and translated had no great major works that could serve as gates of the Dharma.
translations.idiomatic: Yet what they preached and translated included no major works of renown that could serve as gates of the Dharma.

sentences.zh: 梁武大崇佛法，于華林園中，總集釋氏經典，凡五千四百卷。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang greatly revered the Buddhist Law; in Huilin Garden he collected Buddhist scriptures in all, 5,400 scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang greatly revered the Buddhist Law and, in Huilin Garden, collected Buddhist scriptures totaling 5,400 scrolls.

sentences.zh: 沙門寶唱撰《經目錄》。

translations.literal: The monk Baozhang compiled a Scripture Catalog.
translations.idiomatic: The monk Baozhang compiled a Scripture Catalog.

sentences.zh: 又後魏時，太武帝西征長安，以沙門多違佛律，群聚穢亂，乃詔有司，盡坑殺之，焚破佛像。

translations.literal: Also in Later Wei, when Emperor Taiwu campaigned west to Chang'an, because monks mostly violated Buddhist precepts and gathered in licentious disorder, he issued an edict to the officials to bury them all alive and burn and destroy Buddha images.
translations.idiomatic: Also in Later Wei, when Emperor Taiwu campaigned west to Chang'an, finding that monks mostly violated Buddhist precepts and gathered in licentious disorder, he ordered the officials to bury them all alive and burn and destroy Buddha images.

sentences.zh: 長安僧徒，一時殲滅。

translations.literal: The monks of Chang'an were annihilated at one stroke.
translations.idiomatic: The monks of Chang'an were annihilated at one stroke.

sentences.zh: 自余征鎮，豫聞詔書，亡匿得免者十一二。

translations.literal: In the remaining campaign garrisons, those who foreheard the edict and hid themselves—only one or two in ten escaped.
translations.idiomatic: In the remaining campaign garrisons, those who foreheard the edict and hid themselves numbered only one or two in ten who escaped.

sentences.zh: 文成之世，又使修復。

translations.literal: In the reign of Emperor Wencheng, restoration was again ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the reign of Emperor Wencheng, restoration was again ordered.

sentences.zh: 熙平中，遣沙門慧生使西域，采諸經律，得一百七十部。

translations.literal: During Xiping, the monk Huisheng was dispatched as envoy to the Western Regions to collect various scriptures and vinaya, obtaining 170 titles.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xiping era the monk Huisheng was dispatched as envoy to the Western Regions to collect scriptures and vinaya, obtaining 170 titles.

sentences.zh: 永平中，又有天竺沙門菩提留支，大譯佛經，與羅什相埒。

translations.literal: During Yongping, there was also the Indian monk Bodhiruci, who translated many Buddhist scriptures on a par with Kumārajīva.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yongping era the Indian monk Bodhiruci also translated many Buddhist scriptures, rivaling Kumārajīva.

sentences.zh: 其《地持》、《十地論》，並為大乘學者所重。

translations.literal: His Bodhisattvabhūmi and Daśabhūmikavibhāṣa were both highly valued by Mahayana scholars.
translations.idiomatic: His Bodhisattvabhūmi and Daśabhūmikavibhāṣa were both highly valued by Mahayana scholars.

sentences.zh: 後齊遷鄴，佛法不改。

translations.literal: Later when Northern Qi moved to Ye, the Buddhist Law remained unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Northern Qi moved its capital to Ye, the Buddhist Law remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 至周武帝時，蜀郡沙門衛元嵩上書，稱僧徒猥濫，武帝出詔，一切廢毀。

translations.literal: By the time of Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, the Shu commandery monk Wei Yuansong submitted a memorial saying monks were licentious and excessive; the emperor issued an edict abolishing and destroying everything.
translations.idiomatic: By the time of Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou, the Shu commandery monk Wei Yuansong submitted a memorial declaring monks licentious and excessive; the emperor issued an edict abolishing and destroying everything.

sentences.zh: ，高祖普詔天下；

translations.literal: Then Emperor Wen issued edicts throughout the realm;
translations.idiomatic: Then Emperor Wen of Sui issued edicts throughout the realm;

sentences.zh: 任聽出家，仍令計口出錢，營造經像。

translations.literal: Allowing people to leave home [to become monks], and also ordering per-capita contributions of money to build scriptures and images.
translations.idiomatic: He allowed people to leave home and become monks, and also ordered per-capita contributions of money to build scriptures and images.

sentences.zh: 而京師及并州、相州、洛州等諸大都邑之處，並官寫一切經，置於寺內；

translations.literal: In the capital and at Bingzhou, Xiangzhou, Luoyang, and other great metropolitan areas, the government copied all scriptures and placed them in monasteries;
translations.idiomatic: In the capital and at Bingzhou, Xiangzhou, Luoyang, and other great metropolitan centers, the government copied all scriptures and placed them in monasteries;

sentences.zh: 而又別寫，藏于秘閣。

translations.literal: And also made separate copies, stored in the Secret Archive.
translations.idiomatic: Separate copies were also made and stored in the Secret Archive.

sentences.zh: 天下之人，從風而靡，競相景慕，民間佛經，多於六經數十百倍。

translations.literal: People throughout the realm followed the trend and were swept along, competing in admiration; Buddhist scriptures among the populace outnumbered the Six Classics by tens or hundreds of times.
translations.idiomatic: People throughout the realm followed the trend and competed in admiration; Buddhist scriptures among the populace outnumbered the Six Classics by tens or hundreds of times.

sentences.zh: 大業時，又令沙門智果，於東都內道場撰諸經目，分別條貫，以佛所說經為三部；

translations.literal: During Daye, the monk Zhiguo was again ordered at the Inner Ordination Platform of the Eastern Capital to compile a catalog of scriptures, classifying and organizing them, dividing the scriptures spoken by the Buddha into three divisions;
translations.idiomatic: During the Daye era the monk Zhiguo was again ordered at the Inner Ordination Platform of the Eastern Capital to compile a catalog of scriptures, classifying and organizing them and dividing the scriptures spoken by the Buddha into three divisions;

sentences.zh: 一曰大乘，二曰小乘，三曰雜經。

translations.literal: The first is Mahayana, the second Hinayana, the third miscellaneous scriptures.
translations.idiomatic: The first is Mahayana, the second Hinayana, the third miscellaneous scriptures.

sentences.zh: 其餘似後人假託為之者，別為一部，謂之疑經。

translations.literal: The remainder, appearing to be works falsely attributed by later people, were set apart as one division, called doubtful scriptures.
translations.idiomatic: Works that appeared to be falsely attributed by later people were set apart as one division, called doubtful scriptures.

sentences.zh: 又有菩薩及諸深解奧義、贊明佛理者，名之為論，及戒律並有大、小及中三部之別。

translations.literal: Further, bodhisattvas and those who deeply grasped esoteric meaning and praised and clarified Buddhist doctrine were named treatises; vinaya also had divisions of great, small, and middle.
translations.idiomatic: Bodhisattvas and those who deeply grasped esoteric meaning and praised and clarified Buddhist doctrine were classified as treatises; vinaya likewise had great, small, and middle divisions.

sentences.zh: 又所學者，錄其當時行事，名之為記。

translations.literal: Also learners recorded their contemporary activities, naming them records.
translations.idiomatic: Learners also recorded their contemporary activities, classifying them as records.

sentences.zh: 凡十一種。

translations.literal: In all eleven kinds.
translations.idiomatic: In all there were eleven kinds.

sentences.zh: 今舉其大數，列於此篇。

translations.literal: Now the grand totals are presented and listed in this fascicle.
translations.idiomatic: The grand totals are here presented and listed in this fascicle.

sentences.zh: 右道、佛經二千三百二十九部，七千四百一十四卷。

translations.literal: At right: Daoist and Buddhist scriptures—2,329 titles, 7,414 scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: In all: Daoist and Buddhist scriptures—2,329 titles, 7,414 scrolls.

sentences.zh: 道、佛者，方外之教，聖人之遠致也。

translations.literal: Daoism and Buddhism are teachings outside the conventional world, the far-reaching achievements of sages.
translations.idiomatic: Daoism and Buddhism are teachings outside the conventional world—the far-reaching achievements of sages.

sentences.zh: 俗士為之，不通其指，多離以迂怪，假託變幻亂於世，斯所以為弊也。

translations.literal: When laymen practice them without grasping their intent, they mostly depart into the abstruse and bizarre, falsely attributing transformations that disorder the world—this is why they become harmful.
translations.idiomatic: When laymen practice them without grasping their intent, they mostly depart into the abstruse and bizarre, falsely attributing transformations that disorder the world—this is their harm.

sentences.zh: 故中庸之教，是所罕言，然亦不可誣也。

translations.literal: Therefore the doctrine of the Mean is rarely spoken of [in such contexts], yet it also cannot be denied.
translations.idiomatic: The doctrine of the Mean is therefore rarely spoken of here, yet it cannot be denied.

sentences.zh: 故錄其大綱，附於四部之末。

translations.literal: Therefore their grand outline is recorded, appended at the end of the four bibliographic divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Their grand outline is therefore recorded, appended at the end of the four bibliographic divisions.

sentences.zh: 大凡經傳存亡及道、佛，六千五百二十部，五萬六千八百八十一卷。

translations.literal: In grand total, classics and treatises extant and lost, together with Daoist and Buddhist [works]: 6,520 titles, 56,881 scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: In grand total, classics and treatises extant and lost, together with Daoist and Buddhist works: 6,520 titles, 56,881 scrolls.
